description:
Malaysia Grocery Prices & Promo Tracker

One normalised Malaysian grocery price feed from 99 Bulksales, Jaya Grocer and KPDN PriceCatcher, with pack-size parsing, RM per kg / litre / piece unit prices and run-to-run change tracking.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Product price row: $0.001; platform usage billed to your account.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/my-grocery-prices.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

jayaProductTypes.description: Optional. Keep only Jaya Grocer products whose product_type equals one of these values (case-insensitive), e.g. Beverages, Frozen.
jayaProductTypes.title: Jaya Grocer product types

maxItemsPerSource.description: Cap on delivered rows for each source. 99 Bulksales and PriceCatcher stop fetching once the cap is reached; Jaya Grocer stops paging. Default 15 per source = up to 45 rows.
maxItemsPerSource.title: Max rows per source

onlyChanges.description: When trackChanges is on, deliver and charge only rows whose changeType is not unchanged. Requires trackChanges.
onlyChanges.title: Only push changes

pcIncludeCookedFood.description: PriceCatcher also prices cooked dishes (item group MAKANAN SIAP MASAK). Off by default so the feed stays comparable grocery items.
pcIncludeCookedFood.title: Include cooked food

pcItemCategories.description: Optional. Keep only these PriceCatcher item categories, matched case-insensitively (e.g. AYAM, BERAS, MINYAK DAN LEMAK).
pcItemCategories.title: PriceCatcher item categories

pcLookbackDays.description: Window ending at the newest date in the data. The latest observation per outlet and item inside the window is returned.
pcLookbackDays.title: PriceCatcher lookback (days)

pcRetailers.description: Premise-name patterns used to keep PriceCatcher outlets. Food courts and restaurants are always excluded.
pcRetailers.title: PriceCatcher retailers

pcStates.description: Optional. Keep only outlets in these states, matched case-insensitively (e.g. Selangor, Johor, W.P. Kuala Lumpur).
pcStates.title: PriceCatcher states

searchTerms.description: Optional. Every word of a term must appear in the product name or slug (case-insensitive). Leave empty to collect the catalogue in source order. The prefill ["maggi"] is a small example run.
searchTerms.title: Search terms

sources.description: Retailer and open-data sources to collect. 99 Bulksales is a wholesale catalogue (sitemap discovery, product pages), Jaya Grocer is a Shopify storefront (/products.json), PriceCatcher is the KPDN open dataset on data.gov.my.
sources.title: Sources

stateKey.description: Separate change-tracking history per key, e.g. one per product list or region. Sanitised to A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ and - (max 50 characters).
stateKey.title: State key

trackChanges.description: Compare each row with the last run stored under stateKey and add changeType (new, price_down, price_up, promo_start, promo_end, unchanged), previousPriceRm and previousIsPromo.
trackChanges.title: Track changes between runs

name: my_grocery_prices
